title: Don Phillips: humans have the fastest computer

tellings.quote: Humanity has the quickest uh computer built into them than any man-made computer can ever approach.

plain: A man named Don Phillips, who speaks from his time at Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret aircraft design shop, says that human beings carry inside them a faster computer "than any man-made computer can ever approach." He says this to Michels as his own view of what the human mind can do.
